name: Only asking for quiet makes Boop quiet, in every mode
why: VISION.md's Listens (Boop goes quiet when asked) and BEHAVIORS.md §3.3, §4: words with "quiet" in them set quiet mode for the minutes asked, and in quiet mode agent inputs don't reach the brain, yelled or not (a yelled "BE QUIET" is quiet, not hero moment 3's sad mumble); asking Boop to stop being quiet ends it at once, with a happy mumble. Quiet wins over every mode

chatty: agent started → react(feeling: curious, word: hmm|what|oh|okay|code|more|wow|hi|none)

expect: you said → quiet(minutes: 0), react(feeling: happy, word: okay|yay|yes|hi|hello|hooray|good|nice|whee|none)
